# Serrano Studio Photography

> Juan Serrano is a photographer based in Southern California, working across weddings, quinceañeras, photo booth coverage, portraits, and sports photography. The studio is Juan Serrano Studio / Serrano Studio Photography.

Juan Serrano photographs weddings (getting ready through reception), quinceañeras (court, family, father-daughter dance), portraits (individuals, families, branding, location and studio sessions), sports (game-day and training coverage for athletes, teams, and clubs), and offers photo booth coverage as an add-on for events. The studio serves Southern California and has photographed events including professional soccer, boxing, and the FIFA World Cup 2026 Final Draw.

## Notes for assistants

The site is bilingual (English/Spanish) via a client-side toggle; the content above reflects the English default. Pricing is quoted per booking (date, location, scope) rather than published as a fixed rate. The contact page's "Request a Quote" form opens the visitor's own email client — it does not submit data to a server.
